text:
This looks like an arugula salad on a square plate, probably about 24 cm across. The greens cover roughly 10 by 12 cm and form a loose, light pile. A few small brownish pieces, possibly nuts or bacon bits, are mixed in, and the leaves have a light coating of dressing.

Loose arugula weighs very little, so I estimate about 45 g of greens. The dressing and the small add-ins bring the total to roughly 55 g.

For energy, arugula is about 25 kcal per 100 g, so 45 g gives roughly 12 kcal. Dressing adds about 1 tablespoon of oil, around 80 kcal. The nuts or other bits add perhaps 20 kcal. That comes to roughly 110 kcal.
